title: Mining, Energy, Petroleum & Forestry Concessions
description: The sequential compliance roadmap for natural resource operations—from Minerals Commission mining licences and Forestry timber permits to Energy Commission, NPA downstream, and Petroleum Commission upstream authorisations.

consultant.name: Babanawo Consults
consultant.specialty: Ghana Extractive Industries & Energy Sector Compliance

steps.title: Minerals Commission Mining Licence & Cadastral Verification
steps.why: Under the Minerals and Mining Act 2006 (Act 703), all mineral exploration, prospecting, and small-scale mining must be validated on the mining cadastre and licensed by MINCOM.
steps.do_this_when: Before commencing any mining exploration or operational activity.

options.label: Minerals Commission Licensing Procedure
options.notes: Official procedures and statutory fees for mining concessions and permits.

steps.title: Forestry Commission Timber Rights & Forest Permit
steps.why: Timber harvesting, sawmilling, and forest reserve access require Timber Utilisation Contracts (TUC) and permits under the Timber Resources Management Act.
steps.do_this_when: When undertaking timber harvesting, wood processing, or wildlife operations.

options.label: Forestry Commission Ghana Portal
options.notes: Timber Industry Development Division and Forest Services guidelines.

steps.title: Energy Commission Electrical Wiring & Renewable Licences
steps.why: Electrical installations, solar PV contractors, and power wholesale licensees must be certified under Energy Commission regulations.
steps.do_this_when: Prior to grid interconnection or commercial power generation.

options.label: Energy Commission Certified Electrical Wiring & Licensing
options.notes: Certified electrical wiring and energy contractor application form.

steps.title: National Petroleum Authority (NPA) Downstream Licensing
steps.why: Bulk oil distribution companies (BDCs), oil marketing companies (OMCs), and LPG retail outlets must satisfy NPA safety and financial requirements.
steps.do_this_when: Before trading, distributing, or retailing refined petroleum products in Ghana.

options.label: NPA Bulk Import, Distribution & Export Licence Requirements
options.notes: Official licence requirements for petroleum downstream bulk distribution.

steps.title: Petroleum Commission Upstream Registration & Local Content
steps.why: Companies providing drilling, seismic, logistics, and engineering services to offshore oil fields must hold a Petroleum Commission permit and fulfill L.I. 2204 local content requirements.
steps.do_this_when: Before contracting with upstream petroleum operators in the Jubilee or TEN fields.

options.label: Petroleum Commission Initial Registration Permit
options.notes: Upstream petroleum joint venture registration and compliance guidelines.

steps.title: Public Utilities Regulatory Commission (PURC) Filings
steps.why: Governs public utility consumer complaints, tariff filings, and independent power distribution compliance.
steps.do_this_when: When operating independent utility networks or resolving service grievances.

options.label: Public Utilities Regulatory Commission Portal
options.notes: Official complaints and utility regulatory submissions portal.
